description: Snapshot every environment in an ordered chain (e.g. DEV, TEST, ACC, PROD) and compare each adjacent pair. Returns one report per pair plus the first stage where drift appears. Snapshots go to <dir>/<label>, reports to <dir>/reports.

agents.description: Agent schema names or ids to clone; default: every agent pac copilot list returns

clientId.description: Entra app (client) id for MSAL. Defaults to CPS_CLIENT_ID, then the first-party VS Code id.

includeDataverse.description: Default true: flows, connection references, environment variables and publish state via Dataverse (needs cs_login; skipped silently otherwise)

solution.description: Solution unique name to record version/managed state for

tenantId.description: Entra tenant id. Defaults to the workspace sync metadata, then CPS_TENANT_ID.

name: cs_compare_environments
title: Compare a DTAP chain
